offence_note: Assault police officer, dangerous driving, failing to stop, possession of stolen property
sentence_quote: The trial judge held that a sentence of five years was appropriate. He gave the appellant two for one credit for the fourteen and a half months he had spent in pre-trial custody (twenty-nine months). He therefore sentenced the appellant to thirty-one months’ imprisonment.
note: Trial judge took Aboriginal status into account; no weight detail shown.

offence_note: Historical sexual intercourse with, indecent assault of, step-daughter
sentence_quote: The sentence imposed on count 1 was 18 months; on Count 2, 18 months concurrent; and on Count 4, six months concurrent.
note: Extradition custody of 100 days not credited; appeal dismissed.

sentence_quote: It has been pointed out that the court failed to allocate the total sentence of six years among the various convictions.
note: Addendum only allocating six-year total; main appeal outcome not shown. Credit of 4.5 months applies to forgery counts.

offence_note: Mischief, possession of restricted firearm, possession of methamphetamine
sentence_quote: the trial judge imposed concurrent sentences of 15 months’ imprisonment (450 days), less credit for pre-sentence custody (PSC) in the amount of 68 days.
note: One drug count reduced to 365 days less 68 days credit (297 days) concurrent; other sentences unchanged.

offence_note: Offences not shown; non-disclosure of fingerprint identity
note: Conviction set aside, new trial ordered.

sentence_quote: I am sentencing you to a conditional sentence of imprisonment of two years less a day, subject to the statutory conditions set out in Section 742.3
note: Conditional sentence with house arrest conditions.

offence_note: Fraud and false pretences using worthless cheques
sentence_quote: we order that the respondent serve the remainder of his sentence of 13 months for these indictable offences in a Provincial Institution.
note: Conditional sentence replaced by jail; restitution orders stand but amount not shown; probation as set by trial judge.

offence_note: Possession of cannabis for trafficking; theft of electricity over $5,000
sentence_quote: a fit sentence would be 12 months in jail. I am going to give you credit for the 67 days that you spent in custody at a ratio of one and a-half days for every day you spent in pre-trial detention, so I am giving you credit for 101 days.
note: Joint submission; count 3 is 30 days concurrent; victim surcharge waived; forfeiture adjourned; recommended Lower Mainland.

offence_note: Two dwelling break and enters to commit voyeurism
sentence_quote: I suspend the passing of sentence and place SMNC on probation for a period of two years.
note: Voyeurism counts conditionally stayed; offender had autism.

offence_note: Offering an indignity to a dead human body
sentence_quote: on the offence to which you have pled guilty, I sentence you to a period of imprisonment for 18 months. That imprisonment is to be served in jail and not in the community.
note: Acquitted of manslaughter; conditional sentence refused.

offence_note: Offences not shown; appeal on pre-sentence custody conditions
sentence_quote: we allow the appeal, reduce the custodial portion of the sentence to time served and the probation order will remain in force on the terms ordered by the trial judge.
note: Offences not stated; father described as Aboriginal; original sentence 8 months after 7 months credit.

offence_note: Sexual assault and unlawful confinement; dangerous offender
sentence_quote: the sentencing judge found Mr. Bragg to be a dangerous offender and sentenced him to an indeterminate period of incarceration.
